what_this_is: Every committed reader-A provenance file (crates/clean-verify/src/spec/core_spec/generated/*.prov.json) is the output of ONE run of the crystal-A2 projector over the dump(s) it names (its `dump` and `merged_artifacts`, each sha256-pinned inside it), and nothing else may write one. None of those dumps is on this machine (searched 2026-09-25: `inputs_on_this_machine`), so none of these files can be regenerated here: each is pinned to the bytes that run wrote, beside the commit that first held them. A byte change is therefore either a real run -- re-pin the row with that run's commit -- or a hand edit, and scripts/check_crystal_fixture_pins.py refuses it either way until the row says which.

crates/clean-verify/src/spec/core_spec/g.note: Reader A (the committed scripts/crystal_a2_project) re-run 2026-10-07 over the 047ebd051 source-bound rebaseline's dump (sha256 052660686e21...83b3b, the binary every 2026-10-07 fixture's current_source_bound_pin names). Its core text was byte-identical to the committed one; these are the provenance bytes that run wrote, unedited. The dump was transient scratch, removed after the run, so inputs_on_this_machine is false.
